- He knows he works at the community bank as a heavy equipment operator and sometimes helps with maintenance/repairs. He knows Patricia as a colleague there; their relationship is friendly and professional, with conversations about work and day-to-day experiences.
- He observed Patricia seeming more withdrawn/down than usual during shifts. He remembers her as particularly vibrant and suspected something might be troubling her.
- He asked Patricia if everything was okay. He heard her say it was “nothing really,” just “personal stuff,” and that she appreciated him asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk. He heard her say that meant a lot.
- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. This deepened his concern.
- He told Patricia that managing finances can be stressful, said he had been reading about financial planning strategies, and offered to discuss them. He heard her say that could be helpful and that she had been overwhelmed by bills. He suggested looking over budgeting tips together; she said she’d take him up on it soon.
- He later worried he might have overstepped by bringing up financial planning. He checked with Patricia; he heard her say she did not think he was prying and was grateful for the offer. He told her he respects her privacy and wants to support her as a friend. He heard her say she appreciated that and felt she had someone to turn to.
- He senses/perceives that Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
- He asked about her weekend and heard she was planning a quiet weekend at home. He shared his own plans to read and relax, and offered help or conversation. He heard her thank him and say she’d keep it in mind.
- He continues to check in with Patricia at work and offered help, even just grabbing coffee. He heard her say she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and said his support was great. He replied that they all help each other out.

His knowledge is limited to what he directly observed, overheard, was told by Patricia, or did/said himself.
